attributes.title: 2027 New England Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
NEVMA's 2027 New England Veterinary Conference takes place in Portland, Maine, in late September 2027. The published 2027 schedule starts on Thursday, September 23 (invitation-only leadership day and wet labs) and continues with lectures through Sunday, September 26; the page banner reads September 24-27, so confirm the exact days before booking.

NEVMA's FAQ says the conference is not RACE-approved, but its credits are accepted automatically by all six New England states. Veterinary technicians and office staff may attend all educational sessions except labs reserved for veterinarians.

Attendee registration opens in June 2027; 2027 fees have not been announced.
